name: systems
description: Scaffolds low-level / embedded-style C++23 or Rust 1.99.1+ practice components from a free-form problem statement: an ASPICE-style requirements spec, a documented header/module and stub implementation, and a comprehensive test suite (threads, processes, fault injection) that starts in the TDD red state. Constraints follow automotive / robotics practice (ISO 26262, MISRA C++:2023, AUTOSAR C++14 guidance, zero steady-state heap, no panics/exceptions), targeting POSIX (Linux, embedded Linux, QNX).
suggestedPrompts: Set up a systems problem: a pub/sub interface over a shared-memory ring buffer, safe across processes and threads
Set up a systems problem in Rust: a bounded FIFO queue with fixed compile-time capacity
Set up a systems problem: a lock-free single-producer/single-consumer queue for an ISR-to-task handoff
Set up a systems problem: a fixed-block memory pool allocated once at init, O(1) allocate/free, thread-safe
Set up a systems problem: a watchdog supervisor that detects missed heartbeats from worker processes
